title: The Amazing Spider-Man #1000: A Milestone Anniversary Celebration with Ultimate Spider-Man Nostalgia
text:
Marvel celebrates the 1000th issue of The Amazing Spider-Man with a giant-sized anthology featuring legendary creators like Brian Michael Bendis, Stuart Immonen, Frank Miller, and more, including a nostalgic tribute to the Ultimate Spider-Man universe.
The Amazing Spider-Man is set to reach a monumental milestone with the release of issue #1000 in September 2026, though the issue is numbered as #36 in the current run.
This colossal celebration of Peter Parker's legacy will be giant-sized and feature contributions from legendary creators who have defined Spider-Man's comics history. The primary story, written by Joe Kelly with art by Pepe Larraz, promises to introduce a terrifying new villain named Ravage, but the true draw lies in the anthology of anniversary tales crafted by iconic teams.
Among them, Dan Slott and Marcos Martin reunite, Frank Miller partners with Peach Momoko for the first time, and Brian Michael Bendis joins Stuart Immonen for a nostalgic return to the Ultimate Spider-Man universe. This issue is not just a milestone; it is a love letter to fans who have followed Spider-Man through decades of evolution.
Bendis and Immonen's collaboration, titled 'The Gesture,' is particularly significant for fans of the Ultimate Spider-Man series, which began in 2000 and reimagined Peter Parker for a modern audience. Although Bendis worked primarily with Mark Bagley on that series, his partnership with Immonen on later arcs like 'Ultimatum' and 'Spider-Men' left an indelible mark.
Speaking to CBR, Bendis expressed his excitement: 'What an incredible honor to be part of this jam-packed and absolutely gorgeous anniversary celebration of this character that means so much to all of us. Re-teaming with Stuart Immonen, one of the very best to have ever done it, is a dream come true.
I am so honored to have made so many Marvel comics with him over the years and I used this grand opportunity to try to give him something that hits on all of his many strengths. He took it and made something exquisite.
' The story sees Spider-Man teaming up with the Avengers against a horde of villains, evoking memories of the 'War of the Symbiotes' arc where Peter unknowingly bonded with the symbiote again, fighting both his allies and his inner demons. Beyond the Bendis/Immonen tale, #1000 boasts an all-star roster of contributors. Noah Hawley, known for his work on Fargo and Legion, makes his comic book debut, while Frank Miller and Peach Momoko offer a unique artistic fusion.
The issue serves as both a standalone event and a celebration of Spider-Man's enduring appeal across multiple dimensions, including characters like Miles Morales, Gwen Stacy, and others from the Spider-Verse. The official solicitation reads: 'THE BIGGEST ISSUE IN AMAZING SPIDER-HISTORY! Spider-Man faces his greatest fear and his most frightening new villain in decades... RAVAGE!
Plus, some of the greatest creative minds on Earth honor one thousand issues of THE AMAZING SPIDER-MAN!
' With a release date set for September 16, 2026, this anniversary issue is poised to be a landmark moment for Marvel, reminding readers why Spider-Man remains one of the most beloved superheroes of all time
